text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Now, the pack heads into the final straight—!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Chrono-san's passion— No, but—I won't back down!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...――!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I... won—
I actually won...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, aaah!
I was able to... grasp the autumn flowers in my hands!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes!
Thank you very much—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOO...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet, congratulations!"
"I got goosebumps!" "Chrono, that was so close!"
"This generation really is strong! They aren't backing down!!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...A great radiance――

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
It's frustrating... It really is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Chrono-san—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: B-But, I... was happy too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Because the entire racecourse was engulfed
in wild excitement over the race we wove together."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
We have surely proven the strength of our generation.
It is all thanks to you.
My own heart is burning with the desire to win next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or conquered the Shuka Sho.
Together with Chrono Genesis, they delivered a race
worthy of proving their generation's tremendous strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...But—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Today's guest is this person!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Here with us is Chrono Genesis, who not only competes
in the Twinkle Series herself, but also possesses
a profound knowledge of racing!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you so much.
I look forward to working with you...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Today, together with Chrono-san, we'll unravel the history of the race!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A grand pattern woven from the warp and weft of time...
I believe that is what racing history is.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why... I, too, wish to create historic drama and leave behind... my own hoofprints."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "With so many Tiara route Umamusume achieving great success lately, the racing world has reached a turning point."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If there's something new I can depict within all that—
perhaps it lies in the Grand Prix races, like the Arima Kinen and Takarazuka Kinen, where runners carry the hopes and dreams of their fans.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (She's been performing remarkably ever since the 'Shuka Sho'.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (TV, social media, racing magazines—there's just too much to keep track of...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (...Just as I thought. I couldn't draw the public's attention after all.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...No, but I managed to grasp the flowers.
It'll be all right, for sure.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Run, run, run all the way through. If I do, then even I should be able to shine a light on him.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Run, run, run all the way through. If I do, then even I should be able to shine a light on her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want to keep pushing, there's still so much more in me—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some time has passed since the Shuka Sho, and I discussed our upcoming racing rotation with her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Our next target race is... the Kyoto Kinen, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is the kickoff to her spring GⅠ campaign.
The competition is top-notch, and the 2,200-meter distance should play right into her running style.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes, please. I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Um, I was just thinking about how
I'd like to stand on many big stages from now on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
First, in the upcoming race—the exhibition match—
I really want to deliver solid results.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In that high-profile race.
I want to add a single piece, like a cast-iron leaf—
something to support and strengthen the bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And so,
I want to build momentum and take on the Senior Year...!
choice_data_list: I see. ...Alright, let's keep giving it our all!
I see. ...All right, let's keep doing our best from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—...I fondly recall
the sight of her saying those words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I opened UmaTube.
The special feature on the Shuka Sho Umamusume popped up right away.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: "By the way, what is your dream, Bouquet-san?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To present a golden bouquet
to Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Divided equally among the other runners,
Curren Bouquetd'or's dream drifted away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even the interviewer praised it as a heartfelt dream showing their strong bond. However—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An exclusive interview video was not arranged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She didn't captivate people's hearts or spark fiery enthusiasm the way Loves Only You or Chrono Genesis did.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dream itself is noble and wonderful.
Which is precisely why, if there's a reason for this—
choice_data_list: (Is it because the one at the center of that dream is a nobody like me...?)
(Is it because the one at the center of that dream is a nobody like me...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If it was meant to be dedicated to a more prominent, first-rate veteran Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, a bouquet of flowers for Trainer, you say!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
He who has guided so many renowned Umamusume...
I am eager to see what kind of bouquet
his newest student will assemble!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wasn't she meant to bask in even more light?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just like Chrono Genesis and Loves Only You.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could it be that she was able to run true to herself, and on top of that, shine even brighter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I brush aside the creeping anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I signed a contract knowing her dream. In that case,
it's my responsibility to help her pursue it head-on.
choice_data_list: (Let's get results in the exhibition match)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Let's lead her to victory there.
We will pave a path of glory leading into the Senior class."
